name: SazCancel – Auto-Cancel On-Hold Orders
author: alexsazonov

sections.description:
Tired of abandoned On-Hold orders indefinitely blocking your product inventory?

In WooCommerce Core, the built-in Hold stock (minutes) setting only applies to “Pending payment” orders. When customers order via Direct Bank Transfer (BACS), Cheque, or offline invoices, the order is placed in On-Hold status and stock is deducted from your shelves. If the customer never pays, the order sits in your store forever — keeping products in a false “Out of Stock” state and costing you sales.

SazCancel solves this exact gap. It safely and automatically cancels stale On-Hold orders after your chosen delay (e.g., 48 hours or 3 days), allowing WooCommerce Core to natively restock your products.

🛡️ Built for Merchant Safety (Zero-Disaster Guard)

SazCancel is built on strict safeguards to protect merchant orders and store inventory:

  • Simulation Mode (Dry Run) Enabled by Default: Upon installation, Dry Run is ON. SazCancel simulates the process, calculating how many orders and stock units would be released, recording events into an Activity Log without modifying real orders.
  • Eligible Gateways Whitelist: You decide which payment methods are subject to auto-cancellation (e.g. BACS and Cheque). Orders from PayPal, Stripe, COD, or other gateways are never touched.
  • Precise On-Hold Age Tracking: SazCancel measures order age strictly from the exact moment the order entered On-Hold status (not from creation date). If a manager temporarily toggled an order to On-Hold 10 minutes ago, it won’t be prematurely cancelled!
  • Last-Moment Status Revalidation: Before executing cancellation, SazCancel revalidates the order in real time. If the order was paid or moved to Processing or Completed, the job immediately exits.
  • Safe Legacy Recovery Baseline: Old On-Hold orders placed prior to plugin installation receive a fresh, full grace period from the moment they are first detected. No sudden cancellations!
  • Native WooCommerce Restock: SazCancel lets WooCommerce Core handle stock restoration via $order->update_status('cancelled'). The core wc_maybe_increase_stock_levels() function safely returns the exact items back to stock.
  • Action Scheduler Event Queue: Powered by WooCommerce’s native Action Scheduler with duplicate job prevention (unique = true). No heavy cron database scans.
  • Activity Audit Log: See the last 30 automated events, cancellations, and simulations right on your settings screen.
  • 100% HPOS Native: Fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (custom_order_tables) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
  • 100% On-Premise PHP: Self-contained code with zero external tracking, no third-party APIs, and no subscriptions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sazcancel-auto-cancel-on-hold-orders directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > SazCancel to review your settings.
  4. Select your eligible payment gateways (e.g., BACS), set your cancellation delay (e.g., 72 hours), and test via Simulation (Dry Run) mode.
  5. When ready, click Activate Live Mode.
sections.faq:
Does SazCancel cancel orders immediately after installation?

No. SazCancel activates in Dry Run (Simulation Mode) by default. It analyzes your store and shows you a live preview of which orders would be affected, without changing any order statuses or inventory. You can switch to Live Mode whenever you are ready.

Does WooCommerce automatically restore product stock when an order is cancelled?

Yes! When SazCancel transitions an eligible order to Cancelled, WooCommerce Core natively triggers wc_maybe_increase_stock_levels(). Any inventory previously deducted for that order is automatically added back to your active stock.

What if a customer pays by bank transfer right before the timeout?

If an admin or payment webhook marks the order as Processing or Completed, SazCancel’s Last-Moment Status Revalidation will see that the order is no longer On-Hold and will instantly exit without making any changes.

Can I exclude Cash on Delivery (COD) or specific gateways?

Yes. SazCancel includes a payment gateway whitelist. Only the payment gateways you check (e.g., Direct Bank Transfer BACS) will be monitored. All unselected gateways are completely ignored.

Does SazCancel support High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. SazCancel is 100% compatible with HPOS (custom_order_tables) and WooCommerce Blocks.

  • Initial public release.
  • Event-Driven Action Scheduler queue with duplicate prevention (unique = true).
  • Last-Moment Status Revalidation.

  • Simulation Mode (Dry Run) by default.
  • Activity Audit Log in admin settings.
  • Native WooCommerce stock restoration support.
  • Full WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.
